VTS Scoring Log

NuScience Peptides

nusciencepeptides.com · Albuquerque, NM · Scored August 2026

NuScience Peptides publishes 60+ batch-specific COA documents at nusciencepeptides.com/nuscience-lab-test-results/ accessible without login, with testing dates confirmed through July-August 2026. Third-party testing via HPLC and mass spectrometry is confirmed on every reviewed batch. The results page describes testing as conducted by "independent third-party laboratories" without naming the facility; however, Freedom Diagnostics is identifiable from COA PDF filenames. The COA library is a gallery display rather than a searchable lot-number database. The most significant transparency gap is a no-refund policy - no standard return window exists for unopened products, which is the most restrictive buyer posture among vendors currently scored in the VTS catalog.

69 /100
Moderate
Large public COA library (60+ documents) with strong recency through August 2026. Lab identifiable via PDF metadata but not named on results page. No-refund policy pulls Policy Transparency to 2/5 - the lowest policy score in the current catalog.
Dimension Scores
Dimension Max Notes Score
Third-Party Testing Practice 30 Third-party testing confirmed. HPLC (purity) and mass spectrometry (identity) documented on all reviewed COAs. The results page describes testing as conducted by "independent third-party laboratories" without naming the facility. Freedom Diagnostics is identifiable from COA PDF filenames (e.g., COA_BPC5_Freedom.09.30.25.pdf, COA_5.Amino_Freedom_09.30.25.pdf) - verifiable on close inspection but not prominently disclosed. This partial disclosure earns more than an unnamed-lab claim, but less than a vendor that names the lab and credentials on the page itself. 20/30
Batch Traceability & Verification 20 60+ batch-specific COA documents published. Each entry links to a uniquely named PDF with product and lot identifiers visible in the filename. Dates in PDF filenames confirm per-batch rather than generic documentation. The page is a gallery display rather than a searchable lot-number lookup, so a researcher must manually browse to find a specific batch - no query-by-lot functionality exists. 14/20
COA Accessibility 15 COA library accessible at /nuscience-lab-test-results/ without login or account creation. PDFs directly downloadable. Homepage prominently links to the lab results page. Gallery format without lot-number search is a mild friction point relative to vendors with queryable databases, but the library is genuinely open and comprehensive. 11/15
COA Completeness 15 HPLC and mass spectrometry confirmed. COA scope covers purity and identity. No documented sterility, endotoxin, or heavy metal testing visible in the public library. Testing scope consistent with Freedom Diagnostics' standard analytical service. 9/15
Testing Recency 10 COA library contains documents dated through July-August 2026, confirming an active ongoing testing cadence. Multiple GLP-class compounds show 2026 COA dates. No evidence of stale documentation being recycled. Among the strongest recency profiles in the current VTS catalog. 9/10
Policy Transparency 5 Physical address (Albuquerque, NM) and phone number (704-666-1701) published. No standard return or refund window is publicly documented - NuScience operates a no-refund model. This is the most restrictive return posture in the current VTS catalog; every other reviewed vendor offers at minimum a return window for unopened items. A no-refund policy is not a safety concern, but the absence of a documented buyer remedy for non-defective product is a verifiable transparency gap in this dimension. 2/5
Operational Track Record 5 Vendor claims 20+ years of industry experience. Physical address in Albuquerque, NM and phone number publicly documented. Long claimed history is credited; consistent catalog depth and active COA production support genuine ongoing operation. Full 5/5 is not awarded as independent domain-age verification of the complete operational history is limited. 4/5

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
No community-commissioned independent test results identified in public forums as of August 2026. This field will be updated as independently sourced results are published.
Community Experience
Community feedback cites catalog depth and COA availability as positives. The no-refund policy surfaces occasionally in buyer discussions as a friction point for first-time purchasers. No significant fulfillment or product consistency complaints identified in publicly indexed sources.
Scoring Notes
Strong COA volume, partial lab disclosure
60+ publicly accessible COA documents is among the largest libraries in the VTS catalog. Freedom Diagnostics is identifiable from PDF filenames without requiring any account access. Naming the lab explicitly on the results page - the step that vendors like Ascension Peptides and Ion Peptides take - would materially improve the score on the Third-Party Testing dimension.
No-refund policy is the clearest policy gap
Every other vendor currently scored in this catalog offers at minimum a return window for unopened products. NuScience's no-refund structure is the most restrictive documented buyer posture in the VTS database and is reflected in the Policy Transparency score accordingly. This does not affect the score on any other dimension.
Sources: nusciencepeptides.com/nuscience-lab-test-results/, nusciencepeptides.com/about-us/, nusciencepeptides.com/terms-and-conditions/.
